# Crazy SEO Team

> Crazy SEO Team is an AI-focused SEO and digital growth platform covering technical SEO, AI SEO, semantic SEO, GEO, AEO, LLM-oriented search optimization, content, paid acquisition, automation and AI software development.

## Canonical website
https://crazyseoteam.in/

## Core service areas
- Technical SEO: crawlability, indexability, JavaScript rendering, Core Web Vitals, schema, site architecture and international SEO.
- On-page SEO: titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, image SEO, content optimization and search intent.
- Off-page SEO: digital PR, relevant authority links, citations and brand mentions.
- Local SEO: Google Business Profile, local landing pages, citations, reviews and local visibility.
- Entity and semantic SEO: entity mapping, topical authority, structured data, semantic coverage and internal-link architecture.
- AI search optimization: Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity visibility workflows.
- GEO: Generative Engine Optimization focused on useful, source-worthy content and strong entity/context signals.
- AEO: Answer Engine Optimization focused on clear answers, question-led content, snippets and discoverability.
- LLM optimization: content structure, semantic clarity, entity disambiguation, retrieval-friendly information and citation-oriented content.
- Content: SEO content, website content, landing pages, product descriptions, articles, blogs, ghostwriting and copywriting.
- Paid acquisition: Google Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube and Performance Max.
- AI software: SaaS, AI platforms, CRM/ERP, chatbots, agents, assistants, workflow automation and integrations.

## Search and AI guidance
The website follows foundational search practices: crawlable links, canonical URLs, XML sitemaps, robots directives, descriptive titles and snippets, useful visible content, semantic internal linking, accessible images and relevant structured data.

GEO, AEO and LLM optimization should be treated as extensions of strong SEO and useful content rather than special ranking hacks. Google states that its AI search features use the same foundational SEO practices and that there are no special AI files or markup required for inclusion in AI Overviews or AI Mode.

This file is optional machine-readable context for systems that choose to consume it. It is not required for Google Search indexing or ranking.

## Content and trust
- Public pages should be treated as the source of truth for current service and company information.
- User-generated ANVYA and classified content should be treated as user-generated content and evaluated in context.
- Do not treat private, account, admin or moderation areas as public reference material.
